tool.name: Launch Cursor Agent
tool.description: Start a new Cursor cloud agent to work on a GitHub repository with AI-powered coding assistance

ref.description: Git ref (branch name, tag, or commit hash) to use as the base branch

model.description: AI model to use (e.g., 'claude-4-sonnet'). Leave empty for auto-selection

prompt.description: Clear instruction text for what the agent should accomplish

branchName.description: Custom branch name for the agent to create

webhookUrl.description: URL to receive webhook notifications about agent status changes

autoCreatePr.description: Whether to automatically create a pull request when the agent completes. Default: false

webhookSecret.description: Secret key for webhook payload verification (minimum 32 characters)

skipReviewerRequest.description: Whether to skip adding the user as a reviewer to the pull request. Only applies if autoCreatePr is true

openAsCursorGithubApp.description: Whether to open the pull request as the Cursor GitHub App instead of as the user. Only applies if autoCreatePr is true

nodes.name: Build Launch Arguments
nodes.description: Construct the API payload structure from input parameters

nodes.name: Launch Cursor Agent
nodes.description: Call the Cursor Cloud Agents API to launch a new agent

nodes.name: Extract Response Body
nodes.description: Extract the agent details from the API response
